currentParagraphText: “Of course,” the Sword Saint nodded, and after the two of them comfortably sat down and had some tea served, the real discussion could begin.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Of course,” the Sword Saint nodded, and after the two of them comfortably sat down and had some tea served, the real discussion could begin.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “As you know, the Noboru clan has explored the Path of vampirism for a while, but we have done so in a mostly isolated fashion,” the Sword Saint began to explain. “I visit today with the hope that perhaps an exchange of knowledge can take place, and with the universe beginning to open up, I see no better time. I hope that such an exchange can benefit the many vampires of my clan, allowing them to learn more about what they have become... and perhaps even the history of their heritage.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I hope the Chosen is doing well,” Fairleigh said with a smile. “But let us focus on why you are here and what we can do for one another.”
